body.name: Rank-one \(0.25/0.75\) Markov-mask witness
body.construction: Along \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), define \(W^{\theta,h}_\ell\) using independent baseline states \(A^{\mathrm{init}}_i=A_{i0}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), recorded in \(\mathbb G_0\), and fixed \(0<\theta<h\) with \(h+\theta/2\le B\). For \(j\ge1\), set \(p_{ij}=1/2+(1/4)(-1)^{i+j}(2A_{i,j-1}-1)\), \(C_{ij}=h(-1)^{i+j}(2A_{i,j-1}-1)\), \(Y_{ij}(1)=\mu^1_{ij}=C_{ij}+(\theta/2)(-1)^{i+j}\), and \(Y_{ij}(0)=\mu^0_{ij}=C_{ij}-(\theta/2)(-1)^{i+j}\), where \(A_{i,j-1}=A^{\mathrm{init}}_i\) at \(j=1\). Hence \(M_{ij}=\theta(-1)^{i+j}\), \(\bar p_i=1/2\), and \(M^{\mathrm B}_{ij}=h+\theta(-1)^{i+j}\).
inputs: The explicit bounded-aspect path and amplitudes \(0<\theta<h\) bounded by \(B\).
